tag.description: Tag to which the package will be deployed. Defaults to current tag.

packageVersion.description: Should provide full version. When provided, Package manager version in combination with package name will

reset.description: If set then will reset all metadata for the tag. I.e. will not attempt to provision incrementally.

doNotRevertStateOnError.description: If true keeps tag in invalid state if metadata files have errors.

doNotWaitForRunningActions.description: When true, provision will conitnue with out waiting for current running actions.

skipReferenceProd.description: When true, tag reference/prod will not be upgraded.

test.description: When true, test data is provisioned.
